classification.root_cause: The dispatch branch workflow invoked certification helpers that were newer than the exact candidate checkout: check_openhands_provider_baseline.py was absent from the candidate tree, and check_openhands_certification_gateway.py did not support --auto-routing-output.

failure_details.baseline_helper: mas/scripts/check_openhands_provider_baseline.py was not present after checkout of candidate 1fcaf6cb62c6583efdf0ea1396e3d52329453fc3
failure_details.auto_router_helper: candidate check_openhands_certification_gateway.py rejected --auto-routing-output before producing route evidence

remediation.preflight_change: Dispatch preflight now reads helper contracts from the requested candidate git tree instead of the newer dispatch checkout.
remediation.next_candidate_requirement: The candidate must contain every helper and CLI contract referenced by the manual workflow before dispatch.
